# AuroraLive launch notes

Northwind Media announced AuroraLive today, a managed service for live event delivery. It is built on
AWS Elemental MediaPackage and runs in a single Region.

Maria Lindqvist, head of product, said the first release accepts SRT and HLS input. Studios that still
run baseband plants can bring video in over ST 2110 and keep SCTE-35 ad markers intact. The team
calls the packaging step transmuxing, and it adds under a second of delay.

## What is new

- A dashboard called StreamDeck shows every channel at a glance.
- AuroraLive works with AWS Elemental MediaPackage and with the older MediaLive channels.
- Support for ST 2110 arrives with the second release, and HLS stays the default output.

See [the product page](https://example.com/aurora) for pricing. The company plans a workshop with
Tomás Okafor of Harborview Studios in the spring.
